dictionary.lore: Standard issue equipment for special forces from the Bariula Empire. On top of concealing the wearer with it's dark fabric, it is also infused with magic that conceals their presence when they're in danger. These troops are so afraid of enemies learning the secrets of the robe that when they are captured, not only do they kill themselves, they go as far as destroying all of their equipment.
